title: Western Star Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar #7
description: Western Star "Mammoth" polished hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Choice of 76mm or 88mm heavy duty walled diameter pipe. One piece pipes on main cross pipes pass through drilled heavy duty narrow depth uprights, no butt welds. Additional mid centre pipe for added protection. The narrow uprights reduce the forward projection measurement and suit tight maximum overall length restrictions. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs. Indicator repeaters in main bar which is contoured to match the front wheel profile. The main bar is fitted with 6mm high tensile support gussets and heavy duty lower rail for maximum strength. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to suit customer requirements. Provision for lower mud flaps.
